name: slidetab
title: SlideTab
description: Control SlideTab — the tactile macOS trackpad window & app switcher with Force Touch haptics.
author: slidetab

commands.name: switch-scope
commands.title: Set Switching Scope & Gesture
commands.subtitle: SlideTab
commands.description: Quickly switch between All Windows, Apps Only, Current App, or change trackpad finger gestures.

commands.name: toggle-slidetab
commands.title: Toggle SlideTab
commands.subtitle: SlideTab
commands.description: Pause or resume SlideTab trackpad gestures globally.

commands.name: pause-current-app
commands.title: Toggle Pause in Current App
commands.subtitle: SlideTab
commands.description: Add or remove the frontmost app from SlideTab's per-app auto-pause list.

commands.name: preview-switch-bar
commands.title: Preview Switch Bar
commands.subtitle: SlideTab
commands.description: Pop open the SlideTab Switch Bar on screen for 2.5 seconds.

commands.name: open-settings
commands.title: Open SlideTab Settings
commands.subtitle: SlideTab
commands.description: Open the SlideTab preferences and live trackpad calibration window.
